data.motivesAndTactics: Blot out the moon, murmur, spread disease

features.name: Horde
features.text: When the Swarm has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **2d6** physical damage instead.

features.name: Blinding Multitude
features.text: The Swarm is so thick it blocks the vision of anyone it interacts with. Creatures within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks made against adversaries other than the Swarm.

features.name: Bloodsuckers
features.text: When the Swarm deals damage to a target, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Swarm feed. The target marks an additional HP, and the Swarm clears a HP.
